# Independent visual review — Flux PR #375 phone Tasks

**Source revision:** `d87fde2df4cbddafc8fb6c4771d5d9fda9eab8a2`

**Neutral brief:** `/home/hubert/Develop/flux-evidence-archive/flux375-d87fde2d/neutral-brief.md`. All supplied captures were generated by the `TasksFinalJourney` Docker UI run, with no source overlay. The screenshot hashes are recorded in `SHA256SUMS.screenshots` in the same evidence directory.

**Evidence reviewed:** `chromium/346-tasks-phone-{320,390}-{light,dark}.png` (CSS 320×568 and 390×844, DPR 3, 100% zoom); `chromium/375-feedback-success-{320,390}-{light,dark}.png` (confirmed In progress state with Undo toast); and `chromium/375-feedback-error-{320,390}-{light,dark}.png` (offline error toast). The 320 plain-list captures show the initial task states restored after Undo and toast dismissal. The 390 plain-list captures show the initial All-list state.

**References:** F-026 `docs/design/final/screens/phone-tasks.webp` and `phone-taskfull.webp`, plus the fixed phone structure, soft-volume tokens and S9 toast-with-Undo rule in `docs/design/final/README.md`. I assessed only rendered states and references. These images do not establish behavior, scroll recovery, target size, accessibility, or actual device responsiveness.

## Findings

1. **P2 — The persistent bottom controls cut through task content at 320×568.** In both light and dark plain-list frames, the third task begins near the bottom and is cut off at the opaque bottom-control region; the Create button and dock cover the remainder at this scroll position. At 390×844 all six items fit above the dock, so this is specific to the short viewport. The abrupt cutoff makes the list look clipped and hides the next task’s state and title. Keep sufficient scroll clearance above the dock so a row does not terminate underneath it.

2. **P2 — Feedback toasts cover useful content at 320×568.** The success toast wraps “#4 in progress” onto two lines and sits over the blocked task below it. The error toast is much taller; it covers the lower part of the “Work could not be loaded” recovery content, including the visible area where “Refresh work” appears behind it. At 390×844 the toasts stay in the lower open space and do not cover the list or recovery action. On the short viewport, compact the toast content or reserve space for it so feedback does not conceal the current task or the recovery path.

## Preserve

At 390×844, the All list clearly separates the in-progress agent task, blocked task, open group and done task; status glyphs and words read together, and Claude Code is visibly tagged as an Agent and tied to Ada. Both themes maintain the intended monochrome hierarchy. On the success toast, “Undo” is explicit, and at both widths the toast and floating Create button remain visibly separate. The offline state uses a calm heading, clear preservation message and underlined “Refresh work” action when unobscured.

## Optional polish

At 320px, the project title truncates cleanly with an ellipsis. This is acceptable for the narrow header and is not a finding. The 390px layout remains substantially closer to the phone reference, with its two-choice Mine / All group, grouped task rows, floating Create control and separate Home / Projects / Inbox dock plus Search.

## Superseded observations from earlier evidence

The earlier 390px screenshots showed a duplicate Search control in the project header; the current d87 frames no longer show that header magnifier, so that finding does not apply to this revision. The earlier desktop toast screenshot was captured after Undo; it was a confirmation and did not demonstrate a missing Undo action. The current phone success frames show the explicit Undo action. No desktop frame is part of this packet.
